title: Los cuñados
desc: Her brothers, and the test that is not called one
setting: Julio and Chino have put a beer in your hand and pulled up a third chair.

steps.speaker: Julio
steps.es: Sentate pues. Vos jugás béisbol, ¿o no?
steps.en: Sit down then. You play baseball, right?

options.feedback: Getting in first with your own weakness leaves them nothing to open with. It is the strongest move at that table.
Fine. It hands them the next line and they will use it.
You have just written the whole afternoon for them.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Uy, ¿malísimo? Peor que Julio no creo.
steps.en: Ooh, terrible? Worse than Julio I doubt.

options.es: Eso lo vemos el domingo pues.
options.en: We will see about that on Sunday then.
options.feedback: You took the joke and turned it into a plan. Now there is a Sunday.
Safe. It lets the joke fall on the floor between the three of you.
Correcting the record in a vacilón is how you tell everybody you cannot take one.

steps.speaker: Julio
steps.es: ¿Y qué son tus planes con nuestra hermana?
steps.en: And what are your plans with our sister?

options.es: Serias. Se lo dije a ella y se lo digo a ustedes.
options.en: Serious ones. I told her and I am telling you.
options.feedback: One word, then the reason it is credible. They were not looking for a speech.

options.en: It is still early for that.
options.feedback: Honest, and it is the answer that keeps this conversation going another twenty minutes.

options.es: Eso es entre ella y yo.
options.en: That is between her and me.
options.feedback: In this family it is not, and you have just told two men that they do not count.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.en: Ideay, he answered with no fear at all.

options.es: Ustedes preguntaron derecho, yo contesté derecho.
options.en: You asked straight, I answered straight.
options.feedback: It names what just happened and gives them the credit for it. That is the end of the test.
Fine, and it treats a verdict like a compliment.

options.es: No tenía por qué tener miedo.
options.en: I had no reason to be afraid.
options.feedback: True and hard. The moment was warm until you made it a competition.
